youtube.title: How Napoleon put half the world on the right #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Who decided which side of the road you drive on? In 1794, revolutionary Paris ordered traffic to keep right, and wherever Napoleon's armies marched, his rules marched with them. Britain was never conquered and went the other way, making keeping left the law in 1835. Then its empire spread the left side around the world. Today neither side is better. It's just history, frozen into concrete and steel. Full episode on the channel.
